blocks.label: Practice
blocks.instructions:
Sonar Watch — Practice



You will classify each contact as one of three types:
  • Kilo-A — older Kilo-877 submarine
  • Kilo-B — newer Kilo-877 submarine
  • Biological — sea life (shrimp, dolphin pod, whale, school of whitefish)

    The two Kilos are dangerous and must be told apart. Their signatures are similar — look carefully. Some contacts are ordinary biologicals. Submarines were designed with stealth features that can look biological, so do not rely on a single band. The biologicals tend to have consistent signatures, but there are also unknown biologicals that don't look like anything.

    Scoring and confidence


    After each response, rate your confidence from 1 (guess) to 5 (certain).
  • Correct answers earn 4 points × confidence (so +4 at level 1 up to +20 at level 5)
  • Incorrect answers lose the same amount (−4 to −20)
  • Higher confidence means larger gains when right and larger losses when wrong — use the full scale

    You will see feedback after each trial in practice. Click to begin.

blocks.label: Watch — Regime 1
blocks.rule_text: Regime 1: With Feedback and Reference signatures
blocks.instructions:
Sonar Watch — Regime 1



Conditions are more realistic: frequency bands will often be slightly off. When unsure, make your best guess and give a lower confidence rating.

Some biologicals may be unfamiliar (“unidentified biological”); still classify them as Biological if that is the best fit.

Scoring reminder


  • Correct: 4 × confidence → +4 … +20
  • Incorrect: same magnitude loss → −4 … −20
  • Use the full 1–5 confidence range

    Reference signatures remain available. Feedback after each trial. Click to continue.

blocks.label: Watch — Regime 2 (no reference signatures)
blocks.instructions:
Sonar Watch — Regime 2



Reference signatures are no longer shown. Rely on what you have learned.

You still receive feedback after each trial (whether you were correct, and what the contact was). Keep using calibrated confidence — higher confidence means larger gains when right and larger losses when wrong.

Scoring reminder


  • Correct: +4 … +20 (4 × confidence)
  • Incorrect: −4 … −20

    Click to continue.

blocks.label: Watch — Regime 3 (no reference signatures, no feedback)
blocks.instructions:
Sonar Watch — Regime 3



This is the most realistic watch: no trial-by-trial feedback. You will not be told whether each answer was correct.

Continue classifying contacts and rating confidence as before. Points still accumulate using the same confidence rule, but your score updates only at the end of this block.

Scoring reminder


  • Correct: +4 … +20
  • Incorrect: −4 … −20
  • Same confidence scale (1–5)

    Click to begin the final regime.

blocks.label: Watch — Classification threshold
blocks.instructions:
Sonar Watch — Classification threshold



Final watch under variable water conditions Classify each as Kilo-A, Biological, or Kilo-B. There is no trial-by-trial feedback. Use confidence as before — points still use the same 4×confidence rule and update at the end of the block.

Scoring reminder


  • Correct: +4 … +20
  • Incorrect: −4 … −20

    Click to begin.
